new_destinations.basis: Bowral town point (Wikivoyage Southern Highlands geo); counted sources Wikivoyage Southern Highlands plus town chapters.
new_destinations.notes: Six kept places within 21 km of Bowral. Morton NP (Fitzroy, Belmore, Gullies, Kangaroo Valley, Bundanoon) is a separate proposed destination to avoid overlap. The Hume Highway towns are not Highlands bases.
new_destinations.status: PROPOSAL ONLY: needs description, three reasons with photos, tips, best months and a header (WRITING.md, Pipeline C); not added

new_destinations.name: Morton National Park
new_destinations.basis: OSM Fitzroy Falls Visitors Centre (NPWS hub). Park (skeptic: spread over ~100 km) is large; a 70 km span covers the northern escarpment visitor area.
new_destinations.notes: Every national park is a destination. Pigeon House Mountain is in the park but about 80 km away, so it is standalone. Carrington Falls is in neighbouring Budderoo NP but is reached from the same base; if the owner wants Budderoo as a destination, see the recall gap in fairness.json.
new_destinations.status: PROPOSAL ONLY: needs description, three reasons with photos, tips, best months and a header (WRITING.md, Pipeline C); not added

new_destinations.name: Kosciuszko National Park
new_destinations.basis: Commons geotag median of 63 files on the Main Range; four counted sources including NPWS and Visit NSW.
new_destinations.notes: Park is 6,900 km2. Yarrangobilly (84 km), Cooma, Big Trout and Tumut are left standalone rather than ballooning the span; a 120 km span would take Yarrangobilly. Jindabyne is kept as a gateway spot of the park (overlap rule: not a second destination).
new_destinations.status: PROPOSAL ONLY: needs description, three reasons with photos, tips, best months and a header (WRITING.md, Pipeline C); not added

new_destinations.name: Goulburn
new_destinations.notes: Regional city destination (guide chapter, Hume Highway hub) with the Big Merino and Bungonia NP. Goulburn Rail Heritage Centre is in review and would be a third spot if its opening days are confirmed.
new_destinations.status: PROPOSAL ONLY: needs description, three reasons with photos, tips, best months and a header (WRITING.md, Pipeline C); not added

new_destination_note: Four PROPOSED destinations (Southern Highlands, Morton National Park, Kosciuszko National Park, Goulburn): proposals for the owner, none added. Spot entries under them carry `if_declined`, the standalone spot each becomes if the owner declines. No kept place lies inside Sydney (30 km reach) or Blue Mountains (37 km reach); nearest is Thirlmere Lakes at 75 km from Sydney. Entries with action new-destination (Morton NP, Kosciuszko NP, Goulburn) are the destination proposals themselves and also carry the standalone fallback in if_declined.
